summary: Nine metres of kerb at a side-street corner, house 9 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 9 m away on the same side and apartments 16-22 m away; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb, ending at a side-street junction; no room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park further along the kerb, but No Stopping signs cover this end.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the stretch.
